answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it erodes each epoch unless refreshed by genuine work, drying up like an oasis in drought. A fake farm can flash across the lagoon for a moment, but every idle clone's weight dulls from sable-dark to nothing the instant it stops contributing. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts busy forever — a one-time swarm becomes a permanent, compounding bill.
